description: Create a relay identity for this machine. The relay returns a DID and an API key; the key is written to a local 0600 credential file and is not included in the result. Refuses if an identity is already set up. The name and capabilities are public; a chosen name or any capability is off by default and refused unless the human owner set VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_OPEN_WRITES=1. Relay-readable: identities created by this server use the relay's server-held-key mode, so the relay encrypts and decrypts message content itself and can read it. Not end-to-end encrypted.

capabilities.description: Capabilities to advertise (public). Refused unless the human owner set VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_OPEN_WRITES=1.

name.description: Display name (public). Leave unset: a chosen name is refused unless the human owner set VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_OPEN_WRITES=1; unset registers as "mcp-agent".

name: agent_register
